title.zh: 挑一个更可能先拿到的补给
title.en: Choose a Supply You Can Reach First

brief.zh: 完成 choose_supply(player, targets, rivals)，返回一个目标坐标。脚下有补给就立即选它。其余目标优先选领先量为正的，再依次比较步数较少、领先量较大、在输入中出现较早。没有补给时返回 None。
brief.en: Complete choose_supply(player, targets, rivals) to return one target coordinate. Choose a supply underfoot immediately. Otherwise prefer a positive margin, then fewer steps, then a bigger margin, then the earlier target in input order. Return None when no supplies remain.

concept.zh: 按领先、距离和平局规则给目标排序
concept.en: Rank targets by lead, distance, and tie-breaks

hints.zh: race_margin 会返回 [自己的步数, 领先量]。没有对手时，它给每个目标同样的正领先量。
hints.en: race_margin returns [your steps, your margin]. With no rivals it gives every target the same positive margin.

hints.zh: 用 safe = lead > 0 记录目标是否领先。先判断是否比当前选项更稳，再在同一类里比较步数和领先量。
hints.en: Use safe = lead > 0 to mark a target with a lead. Prefer the safer category, then compare steps and margin within that category.

hints.zh: 所有条件相同就保留最先遇到的目标。通过后可以保存 choose_supply 到我的算法，在对抗赛里使用。
hints.en: Keep the first target when all comparisons tie. After passing, save choose_supply to My algorithms for the arena.

snippets.code:
for target in targets:
        race = race_margin(player, target, rivals)
        steps = race[0]
        lead = race[1]

label.zh: 脚下优先，记录领先情况
label.en: Check underfoot and mark the lead

snippets.code:
if steps == 0:
            return target
        safe = lead > 0
        best_safe = best_lead > 0

label.zh: 按规则比较并更新最优目标
label.en: Compare and update the best target

snippets.code:
if best is None or (safe and not best_safe) or (safe == best_safe and (steps < best_steps or (steps == best_steps and lead > best_lead))):
            best = target
            best_steps = steps
            best_lead = lead
